A masked man stole the day's takings from {npc:Iriana}, in Yalahar, and fled over the rooftops. Chase him from bridge to bridge (always choosing the right side of each bridge) to {npc:Jimmy}'s hideout, steal a box of food for him from the cellar of {npc:Pugwah}'s tavern and return the chest to Iriana. The reward is 10 {item:Heaven Blossom|Heaven Blossoms}. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
